name: Transcribe speech — whisper.cpp
description: Turns any audio file into a transcript and a subtitle file, entirely on the CPU. Useful for subtitling generated clips, checking what a TTS voice actually said, or turning a recording into notes.
notes: whisper.cpp small, 466 MB ggml model, built from source into studio/tools — it is a binary, so no Python environment is touched and the ROCm/PyTorch container stays as it is. Measured: 4.5 s of Russian speech transcribed in 1.66 s. The small model makes real spelling errors on synthetic speech (синтеза -> синтиза); use a bigger ggml model if accuracy matters more than speed. Language auto-detect is slower than naming it.
